title: Korea Skiing From Seoul: Easy Shuttle Tips
summary: Planning a ski day trip from Seoul? Learn where shuttle tours pick up, which nearby resort to choose, and what to bring.

slides.title: Book A Shuttle
slides.voice: Korea skiing from Seoul? Skip gear stress. Book a shuttle.

slides.title: Three Pickup Areas
slides.voice: Shuttles pick up in Hongdae, Myeongdong, and Gangnam; many include rentals.
slides.photo_query: ski shuttle bus Seoul Korea resort

slides.title: Closest Major Resort
slides.sub: Konjiam: forty minutes to an hour
slides.voice: Konjiam is about forty minutes to an hour from southern Seoul, the closest major resort.

slides.title: Bring These Layers
slides.voice: Rent skis and boots there; bring gloves, warm layers, and socks.

slides.title: Beat Weekend Queues
slides.sub: Choose a weekday if you can
slides.voice: Choose a weekday: popular resorts can have long weekend lift queues.
